edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, making ownership caller-determined.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership executes.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before committing ownership.
onlyOwner guard gates the privileged token sweep in transferAnyERC20Token.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender].
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom debits allowed[from][msg.sender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to the callee.
constructor initialises balances for the hardcoded holder.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] when computing supply.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the balances mapping.
constructor mints _totalSupply to the token holder.
totalSupply returns _totalSupply adjusted by the zero-address balance.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
transferFrom decrements the allowed mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall overwrites the allowed mapping before the external call.
owner is passed as the recipient of the swept ERC20 tokens.
transferOwnership writes the newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership reads and clears the newOwner state variable.
transfer calls safeSub on the sender balance.
transfer calls safeAdd on the recipient balance.
transferFrom calls safeSub on balance and allowance.
transferFrom calls safeAdd on the recipient balance.
approveAndCall performs an untrusted external call to spender.receiveApproval with remaining gas.
transferAnyERC20Token externally calls transfer on an arbitrary token contract supplied by the caller.
Malicious callee can re-enter transferFrom/approve before the allowance bookkeeping settles.
safeAdd computes c = a + b and then checks for overflow.
safeSub computes c = a - b and relies on require(b <= a).
safeMul computes c = a * b and checks a == 0 || c / a == b.
safeDiv computes c = a / b after require(b > 0).
Parameter a feeds the addition in safeAdd.
Parameter b feeds the addition in safeAdd.
Parameter a feeds the subtraction in safeSub.
Parameter b feeds the subtraction in safeSub.
Parameter a feeds the multiplication in safeMul.
Parameter b feeds the multiplication in safeMul.
Parameter a is the numerator in safeDiv.
Parameter b is the denominator checked by safeDiv.
_newOwner is stored into the newOwner state variable.
tokenOwner is the lookup key for balances in balanceOf.
to is the credit address in transfer.
tokens is the amount moved in transfer.
spender keys the allowance written by approve.
tokens is the allowance amount written by approve.
from is the debit address in transferFrom.
to is the credit address in transferFrom.
tokens is the amount moved in transferFrom.
tokenOwner is the first key of the allowance lookup.
spender is the second key of the allowance lookup.
spender is both the allowance key and the target contract of approveAndCall.
tokens is the allowance amount and the callback argument in approveAndCall.
data bytes are forwarded verbatim to the spender contract callback.
tokenAddress selects the arbitrary contract that is externally called.
tokens is the amount passed to the external token transfer.
fallback unconditionally reverts, so payable calls from any sender cannot proceed.
